# 참조 구현 (reference implementation): test vectors of the exponential smoothing forecast, taken from
# the data and the expected values of the tests of the spreadsheet program that the calculation in
# `src/functions_forecast_ets.rs` is ported from.
#
# Source: https://github.com/LibreOffice/core, commit 2b66365f1b81b7a89bdc1d93788e4c96073fa513,
# `sc/qa/unit/data/functions/statistical/fods/forecast.ets.add.fods` and `forecast.ets.mult.fods`
# (sheet 2; a case that both files hold is here once). MPL-2.0, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md: this
# Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the
# MPL was not distributed with this file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
#
# A case: the kind (add, mult, both, statmult), the targets (or statistic types) `select`, the `values`, the
# `timeline`, `params` (seasonality, data completion, aggregation; fewer means the defaults) and the
# `expect`ed numbers (an error name for a case that gives an error). Dates are day serials. `both`
# stands for the same case in the additive and the multiplicative file.
# Like the calculation, this file is to be replaced by a clean-room one (TODO.md).
